# Operations and release

Run make check before pushes: formatting, lint, strict type checks, behavioral tests, architecture routing, evidence manifests and native HTTP startup. Run make audit online; install hooks with make hooks. CI is prepared; execution on a remote repository is separate.

Watch quality exceptions, workspace conflicts, unauthorized requests, publish versions, candidate/retrieval counts and measured stage times. Keep runtime SQLite local/single-instance, outside source packages. Authentication, shared state, scaling, backups, network isolation and cloud cost budgets require production implementation.

Rebuild source/evidence with make artifacts after behavior changes. Rendered videos use actual synthetic outputs and captions; they are not browser recordings. No production SLA, retailer/customer impact or cloud consumption is inferred from local measurements.
